messages:
maya: Daily async — preflight check for GPU fleet.
What I did: kicked the us-west1 canary (canary-tilt-2026), prewarmed +15 GPUs for the tilt test.
Blockers: AMS quota bump didn't go through (ticket still pending) and saw scheduler thrash around 12:03 UTC.
Today: follow up on CLOUD-4821, land rollback if perf regression persists, and adjust node requests if needed.

jonathan: Can you paste the canary logs? Also pinging @ops-bot for quota status.
Try: `kubectl logs -n inference canary-tilt-2026 --since=10m`

ops-bot: Ticket update: CLOUD-4821 currently in "review" with cloud provider, ETA ~6h. Support case linked.

li: Noted the scheduler thrash — saw increased evictions in eu-west1-ams1 at 12:03 UTC. Suspect bin-packing spike.
Quick mitigation: reduce per-pod gpu request from 24 -> 20 to fit node profiles. I'll open PR for the pod spec.

ash: CR ping — reviewed autoscaler config PR #4583, left a minor nit on cooldowns. @sam can you do final sign-off?

sam: On it. Will take a look in the next 10m. Also request: can we postpone the nightly heavy batch job to 16:00 UTC to lower pressure during warmup? :thumbsup:

maya: Agreed to move batch to 16:00. Added runbook note: if scheduler restarts >3 in 15m, scale down canary and open a short-term buffer.
Runbook snippet added: `if restarts >= 3 -> set canary.replicas=0; notify #incidents`.

jonathan: Saw tail latency bump on small requests — looks like KV cache warm issue. Suggest adding warm header for canary traffic: `x-redwood-prewarm: 1`.

li: Will add header to canary template and include a small synthetic warmup in the deploy job. PR incoming.

ci-bot: Deploy: canary-tilt-2026 promoted -> stable at 1839990300 by ci-bot.

ash: Re: quota — ops recommended requesting a temporary burst via support while provider completes review. I'll draft the request now and tag @jonathan for numbers.

maya: Thanks everyone — following up in INFRA-672 (evictions) and CLOUD-4821 (quota). End of standup. :white_check_mark:
